steps.say: A half is one of two equal parts.

figure.alt: A circle cut into 2 equal parts with 1 part shaded.

steps.say: Both parts must be the same size.

figure.alt: A bar cut into 2 equal parts with 1 part shaded.

steps.say: Half of 8 is 4. Share 8 into 2 equal groups.

hints: Share 10 one at a time into 2 groups.

check.prompt: Which shape has one half shaded?
hints: Half means 2 equal parts with 1 part shaded.
The shaded part and the white part must be the same size.
Count the parts in each shape.
check.explanation: The square cut into 2 equal parts with 1 part shaded shows one half.

figure.alt: A square cut into 3 equal parts with 1 part shaded.

options.why: This shows 1 of 3 equal parts. That is not a half.

figure.alt: A square cut into 2 equal parts with 1 part shaded.
A square cut into 4 equal parts with 1 part shaded.

options.why: This shows 1 of 4 equal parts. That is a quarter.
